/.name: Home
/.title: Telning: picture books where your child chooses the ending
/.description: Wordless picture books for children aged 0–7 from Telning Publishing House. Your child colours the story, chooses the ending and talks about feelings with you.

/tada.name: The TADA way
/tada.title: TADA: talk about a picture book with your child | Telning
/tada.description: TADA is Telning's own way to turn a picture book into a real talk: Talk, Ask, Decide, Act. Built from research on shared reading and our work with families.

/guide.name: For grown-ups
/guide.title: How to read a picture book with your child | Telning
/guide.description: A short, practical guide to reading a Telning book together: what you need, the four TADA steps, questions that work, tips by age, and the TADA guide by email.

/send.name: Send Pim your ending
/send.title: Send Pim your child's ending, get a story card | Telning
/send.description: Take a photo of your child's drawing and fill in a short form. Pim sends back a story card with ideas for your next talk. First name and age only, no photos.

/about.name: About us
/about.title: About us: the scientists behind Telning books
/about.description: Telning Publishing House is a small team of cognitive and behavioural scientists in Sweden. Meet the founder, see how a book is made, and read our promises.

/pim.name: Meet Pim
/pim.title: Meet Pim, the Telning character who asks: what would you do?
/pim.description: Pim is a small hedgehog with three stars on its head. Pim listens, wonders and chooses, and writes the letters and story cards that come from Telning.

/teachers.name: For teachers
/teachers.title: Wordless picture books for the classroom | Telning
/teachers.description: How teachers use Telning's wordless picture books: every child can join, whatever language they speak at home. TADA for the whole class, groups or one-to-one.

/privacy.name: Privacy notice
/privacy.title: Privacy notice | Telning
/privacy.description: How Telning Publishing House handles data on this website, on the email list and in the emails you send us. Plain words, no cookies, no trackers.

/childrens-privacy.name: Children's privacy notice
/childrens-privacy.title: Children's privacy notice | Telning
/childrens-privacy.description: What we collect when a parent sends a drawing for a story card, why, how long we keep it, who processes it, your rights, and how to contact us. For parents.

/terms.name: Terms
/terms.title: Terms | Telning
/terms.description: The terms for using telning.com and the Telning story-card service, from WelloWork AB, the company behind Telning Publishing House. Short and in plain English.
